item.title: Missouri raises non-resident migratory bird hunting permit fees
item.description: Beginning Jan. 1, 2026, non-resident hunters pursuing migratory birds in Missouri will be required to purchase a new Non-Resident Migratory Bird Permit costing $60, under changes approved by the Missouri Conservation Commission.
